race.comment: The big one of the day and Patrick Payne looks to have found a suitable third-up option for BLACK PEPPERMINT (1), who ran above expectations and got up for second at big odds at his latest appearance at Caulfield Heath over 1800m. This is a step back in grade and should be nearing peak fitness. SPYLARK (7) is yet to find the frame in two runs since resuming from a spell, the latest when fourth over 2050m at Murtoa after she got a long way back. Has a strong record at the third run in and is expected to feature in the finish. ARISTONOUS (4) disappointed last time when sixth over 2100m at Sandown after a close second at Murtoa the run prior. Appeals back in trip this time so he shapes as one to consider. The well-travelled BLACKLIST (5) is on debut for Nathan Hobson and while he'll probably benefit from the run, it's worth keeping a very close eye on the market. VERONA RUPES (8) lacks the class of some rivals, but will race on speed which could see him give a sight.
